title: NSF awards $199,009 for responsible AI use in engineering education
body: Suman Saha received a $199,009 National Science Foundation grant through the PFE: Research Initiation in Engineering Formation (RIEF) program for “Research Initiation: Scaffolding Responsible AI Use through Conversational Microlearning for the Professional Formation of Engineers.” Saha serves as principal investigator, with Stephanie Cutler and Ibukun Osunbunmi as co-principal investigators. The award supports the project from September 2026 through August 2028.
